CustomField.description: The comparison value. For Literal, typed as text and converted to the field's type (numbers, dates as YYYY-MM-DD, booleans as true/false, comma-separated for in and not in). For Relative Date, a whitelisted date literal such as LAST_N_DAYS:30, THIS_MONTH or LAST_90_DAYS. Ignored for is null, is not null, and Routed Record Field.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Value to compare against. Comma-separate for in / not in.
CustomField.label: Value
